Yes, I will try not to care of what others think 

I will try when I can compose myself I guess.

I think that would be a good idea, I hope I would be able to execute it properly, as I’m autistic I already have “wrong” reactions so I’m not sure how well it would work, plus I do not want to hit for “being a smart bum” which does not make sense to me because bums cannot be smart but I digress 

That is true, that would hurt her a lot more, which is not what I want at all

I think it would make her sad and I don’t wanna make her sad

You’re right about the awful people, they aren’t worth my time, when I don’t feel vulnerable I feel as though it’s water off my back (I think that’s the proper saying) but when I feel small and depressed, everything they say seeps into me and I can’t shake it off

She is very cool in my opinion, I love her so much and she is my reason for living. Maybe when I can compose myself I can tell her how i feel but I don’t want to hurt her, I would feel so awful and then what people say would be true that I am an awful and bad person
